stages.name: 1. Linear step: mean, pre-activation covariance, var and C_off
stages.lines: Current 2334-line file. It gained the V41 MU and V37_ORACLE_LAYERS switches while I was reading it, which shifts everything after line 1047 by +10 relative to the 2324-line version. Lines: 1040-1062 (mu = W mu at 1041; V41 MU oracle at 1042-1047; li=0: C_pre = w32^T w32 at 1055; trimmed layer: var at 1053). 1311-1319 with _family at 1017-1032: W C is computed inside the young-leg Strassen family, in the newborn slot's P position. 1343-1348 with _sym_product at 2075-2092: C_pre = (W C) W^T; last layer var = rowsum((W C) o W) at 1346. 1371-1376: var = max(diag C_pre, 1e-10), C_off = zero_diag(C_pre). C itself is assembled at 1951-1954 and parked in legs['AP0'][k_b,1] at 1958.
stages.inputs: Post-activation mean K1v (plus delta if the corr rider is on) and post-activation covariance C = (K11 + K11^T)/2 with diagonal K2v, both from layer k-1; W = w32^T.
stages.outputs: mu_k, C_pre (symmetric), var_k, C_off_k (zero diagonal); at the last layer var only.
stages.approximation: Exact linear law (mu = W m, C^z = W C^y W^T). The only deviations are float32 rounding, Strassen-Winograd rounding (level 6, leaf 16) and the 1e-10 floor. fentry measures this representation entry N^z at 0.1% of Delta C^z, with Monte Carlo self-consistency 1e-7. Not a creation site.
stages.observable_in_dumps: Free dumps: var_k and C_off_k (z level), plus pk1v, K2v, K11 at layer k-1 via KEEP_EXTRA=pk1v,K2v,K11. Oracle dumps: varown_k, C_offown_k, muown_k. fentry.py computes N^z = Cz - W Cy W^T.
stages.exact_counterpart: C^z_k = W C^y_(k-1) W^T. Monte Carlo can measure it: mu, var, cov against mu_y, var_y, cov_y in mc4_off*_{full,h0,h1}.npz (the fentry consistency line).
stages.oracle_hook: Existing: V37_ORACLE=VAR,COFF[,MU] with V37_ORACLE_LAYERS=<list> (1042-1047, 1377-1386). Only var and C_off are replaced after the step; the W C that rides the family is not.

stages.name: 2. Gate and carry: product-gate first-order transport of all carried kappa3 content
stages.lines: 1781-1788: w1 = W_all[:, i11] = Phi, w2 = W_all[:, i21] = rho = phi/s, w1_prev. 1789-1795: young dense legs scaled in place by diag(w1) at slots [ka, k). 1071: WD = W diag(w1_prev) for Z, Zf and Qc. 1088: Qp = diag(w1_prev) Qc at a join. 1814: the newborn A leg is born as diag(w1) C_off. 1796-1802: D3_w = w1^3 D3, D21_w = w1_i^2 D21_ic w1_c.
stages.inputs: alpha = mu/sigma of z_k (the chain's mu, the chain's or the oracle's var); A_s, P_s, Z_s, Zf_s, Qc at layer k; D3, D21 (own or oracle).
stages.outputs: y-level legs diag(w1) A_s and diag(w1) P_s, used by the next family or join; WD; D3_w and D21_w, the product-gated y slices of all carried content, which are subtracted at birth.
stages.approximation:
Every entry of every carried source is mapped to y_k by Phi_a Phi_b Phi_c.
- All-distinct entries: this is exactly the first-order law (note XXXIV support preservation; mclegs fits leg1 at 0.97-1.03).
- Omitted for carried content at every layer: all second-order cross terms. These are the gate covariance T_abc rho_a rho_b C_ab, T x Gamma, and the gate terms from kappa4 tangents. chain-anatomy puts the product-gate error at 1.5-2.4% of the gate per layer, zero mean, compounding over a source's life, with no O(n^2) fix.
- Pair-supported entries: the product gate is already wrong at first order. The true y coefficients of D21_ic are (Phi_i - m_i rho_i) Phi_c and m_i(1 - Phi_i) rho_c on the transpose. These entries are subtracted (D3_w, D21_w) and rebuilt by the M-block (stage 12), so only the all-distinct class keeps memory.
stages.fitted_elements: none. w1, w2, w3 are the exact gate coefficients c(1,1), c(1,2), c(1,3) at the chain's mu and var.
stages.observable_in_dumps: w1, w2, W_all and D21_w are in the DUMPS dict (1971-1977, via KEEP_EXTRA). LEGS (V30_DUMP_LEGS=1 with V29_DUMP_LAYERS) holds the unscaled A, P and w1. The npz files written by oracle_one.py hold no legs.
stages.exact_counterpart: The first-order product-gated transport of the TRUE full kappa3(z_l): u3_l = E[U_i^3], P_l = E[U_i^2 U_c], S_l = E[d_a U_i^2], with U = (W_(l+1) o Phi_l)(z_l - mu_l), in mc4_off{0,1}_legs.npz. Its all-distinct part leg1 and the law's remainder rem = R3 - leg1 - facet are formed in k3chain.py and k3rem.py. The chain's own counterpart (the readout at l+1 of the slots born before l) is not dumped.
stages.oracle_hook: Carried content cannot be replaced by truth: it is an n^3 tensor that Monte Carlo cannot supply. Measurement proxy: the per-slot readout hook of stage 9, comparing Old_chain(l+1) with (u3_l, P_l). A gate-only oracle already exists (VAR, MU at chosen layers).

stages.name: 3. Age schedule of the old tier (confinement and nesting gates)
stages.lines: 1076-1079: ka_t = max(ka, min(k, li - AGE_OLD)), with no join at the last layer. 1248-1250: kb_t = max(kb, min(ka_t - 1, li - AGE_OLD2)). 816-822 hold the defaults; oracle_one.py _prod overrides them: AGE_OLD 4, AGE_OLD2 8, R_OLD 320, R_OLD2 192.
stages.inputs: Layer index li, current ka and kb, number of sources k.
stages.outputs: ka (slots [0, ka) confined), kb (slots [0, kb) in tier 2), joiner j = ka, mover jb = kb.
stages.approximation:
Not an approximation by itself; it decides when the spectral truncation starts. Production schedule (L = 16), for a source s born at layer s and first read at s+1:
- Dense for its reads at layers s+1..s+4.
- Tier 1 (rank 320) from layer s+5; its 5th transport is folded into the join projection.
- Tier 2 (rank 192 inside tier 1) from layer s+9.

There is a join at EVERY layer 5..14 (10 joins) and a nest move at every layer 9..14 (6 moves). Only layer 15 transports the old tier exactly (Qc <- WD Qc). The readout at layer 14 has 4 young dense, 4 tier-1 and 6 tier-2 sources.
stages.fitted_elements: AGE_OLD = 4 and AGE_OLD2 = 8, tuned on the output (age_gates_16nets: confining after age 3 at rank 320 costs +16.9% raw; nesting after 6 costs +4.75%; nesting after 8 rather than 7 gives -0.79%).
stages.observable_in_dumps: ka and kb in LEGS (V30_DUMP_LEGS) only.
stages.exact_counterpart: No confinement (V21_NO_CONFINE=1). This is chain-internal; Monte Carlo cannot measure it.

stages.name: 4. Join range finder (the subspace of joiner + old tier)
stages.lines:
1080-1161. Production path:
- Om = Qp (V29_WARM_JOIN with OPT 'b'), QPASS = 1, the JB batching off.
- Yq = Aj (dA o Aj^T Qp) + Pj (dP o Pj^T Qp) + Qp Sfull (Qp^T Qp) at 1133-1155.
- OPT 'c': Qn = Yq with no QR (1156-1158).
- The first join (ka = 0) uses the cold sketch w32[:, :320].
- Weights dA = 9 + w2^2 + 9 e^2 and dP = 1 + S3c^2 are built at 2024-2025.
stages.inputs: The joiner's y-level legs Aj, Pj (slot j, already w1-scaled); Qp = diag(w1_prev) Qc; Sfull = Sg + U S2 U^T; dA_j, dP_j.
stages.outputs: Qn (n x 320) = G Qp, span only, with G = Aj dA Aj^T + Pj dP Pj^T + Qp Sfull Qp^T.
stages.approximation: One warm-started power step toward the top-320 subspace of the weighted leg Gram (forward-Lyapunov continuity). The weights are heuristic column energies of the hub (X1 = 3A, Y1 = A w2, M ~ P s + 3 A e), not readout or output sensitivities. The sketch is saturated: three passes move the legs error only 0.0396 -> 0.0393 (D3) and 0.0605 -> 0.0603 (D21).
stages.fitted_elements: R_OLD = 320, the dA/dP weights, QPASS = 1 and the warm sketch; all output-tuned or heuristic.
stages.observable_in_dumps: Not dumped: Qn, Qp, Sg, S2 and U are internal.
stages.exact_counterpart: The unconfined chain (V21_NO_CONFINE=1): legs error 0.0396/0.0605 -> 0.0384/0.0591 (k3_representation_budget), about 6% (D3) and 4.6% (D21) of the error energy. Monte Carlo cannot measure it.

stages.name: 5. Join projection, factor rotation and Gram-core update (gate-renormalised reading metric)
stages.lines: 1167-1187 (JOIN_POST=3): alpha_hat = mu / sqrt((W o W) diag C), sq = sqrt(Phi(alpha_hat)^2 + 0.1); Qt = qr(diag(sq) W Qn); QnF = W^T diag(sq) Qt; QcF = diag(1/sq) Qt. 1208-1220: FAj = QnF^T Aj and FPj = QnF^T Pj into the ping-pong slab. 1221-1233: Tq = QnF^T Qp; FAP <- Tq FAP (Strassen, ROT_SMM); Sg <- Tq Sg Tq^T; U <- Tq U. 1234-1244: aliased Gram Sj, Sg += Sj. 1290-1296: Qc = QcF.
stages.inputs: Qn, W, mu_k, diag of the previous C, Aj, Pj, Qp, the tier-1 factors FAP, Sg, U.
stages.outputs: Basis Qc (n x 320, rows of layer k, Qt scaled by diag(1/sq)); tier-1 factors FA_s, FP_s (320 x n); Gram core Sg = sum_s FA_s dA FA_s^T + FP_s dP FP_s^T; the rotated, no longer orthonormal U.
stages.approximation:
For the joiner and every confined source, A_s(k) := Pi_w W diag(w1) A_s(k-1), where Pi_w is the diag(sq^2)-orthogonal projector onto span(W Qn).
- This is the only lossy operation of the old tier. It is applied at every layer 5..14 to all confined content.
- It is a spectral (Lyapunov-tail) truncation in the reading metric, with no expansion order.
- The metric's alpha uses only the diagonal transport of the previous y variance; it omits s_off^2.
- Output sensitivity on 16 networks, against the shipped rank-384 flat metric: rank 288/320/352 gives +7.47/+2.20/+0.12% raw. The output responds more than the L2 share suggests.
stages.fitted_elements: JP_C = 0.1 (0.03 and 0.5 both give +2.73% against +2.20%), JP_MODE 0, R_OLD = 320.
stages.observable_in_dumps: None: no dump key holds Qc, the factors, Tq or the projection residual.
stages.exact_counterpart: The unprojected transport W diag(w1) A_s of the unconfined chain. Chain-internal only; Monte Carlo cannot measure it.
stages.oracle_hook: V21_NO_CONFINE=1; V32_JOIN_POST in {0..4}; V32_JP_C; the retained-energy hook of stage 4.

stages.name: 6. Nested tier move (rank-192 sub-basis U inside tier 1)
stages.lines: 1245-1289. Tier-2 legs are later formed as (Qc U) FA2 at 1306-1310.
stages.inputs: The mover's rotated tier-1 factors FA1 = FAo[0] and FP1; dA, dP of slot kb; U (already rotated by Tq); S2.
stages.outputs:
- Un (320 x 192), from QPASS2 = 2 passes of qr(G2 Om2) with the cold sketch Om2 = w32[:320, :192] and G2 = S_s + U S2 U^T.
- Tier-2 factors: FA2 = Un^T FA1 for the mover, and T2 FAP2 for the old tier 2 (T2 = Un^T U, Strassen).
- S2 = Un^T G2 Un; U = Un.
- FAP = FAP[1:]; Sg -= S_s.
stages.approximation: A second spectral truncation of the oldest sources (192 of 320), done in tier-1 factor space with the exact r1-space Gram. Every tier-2 source is re-projected by T2 at each move (layers 9..14). Its L2 share is nil (tier off: 0.0395/0.0604 against 0.0396/0.0605). Output: nesting after age 8 rather than 7 gives -0.79% raw; after 6 it costs +4.75%.
stages.fitted_elements: R_OLD2 = 192, AGE_OLD2 = 8, QPASS2 = 2, cold sketch (V29_WARM_NEST off).

stages.name: 7. Old-tier transport between joins, and dense-leg formation
stages.lines: 1297-1299: without a join, Qc <- WD Qc, which is exact; in production this happens only at layer 15. 1300-1310: tier-1 legs4['AP1'][2kb:2ka] = Qc @ [FA; FP] slab as one Strassen family; tier 2: QU = Qc U, legs = QU @ [FA2; FP2].
stages.inputs: Qc, the factor slabs fap4 (offset fa_off) and fap24, U.
stages.outputs: Dense z-level legs: A_s = Qc FA_s and P_s = Qc FP_s for tier 1, A_s = Qc U FA2_s for tier 2. They are written to AP1, then swapped into AP0.
stages.approximation: Exact given the factors. Forming the legs is needed because the (i,i) identification in D3/D21 requires them; it costs n^2 r per leg, about 10% of the bill.
stages.observable_in_dumps: A and P in LEGS; with confinement on these are the formed rank-320/192 legs.
stages.exact_counterpart: The dense legs of the unconfined chain.

stages.name: 8. Young-source, newborn and covariance transport family; thin stacks
stages.lines: 1311-1331: _family(W, w32, 2ka, 2k+2) computes AP1 = W @ AP0 over the young slots (pre-scaled by w1), the newborn's A (diag(w1) C_off) and C; Z <- WD Z (1321); Zf <- WD Zf (1322-1329); ping-pong swap. 1334-1369: at layer 1, a family with the newborn only; WC -> C_pre; the newborn's P := W at 1352 (P = I at birth); Z_new = W Rr (1359); Zf_new = W Ff (1365); s_list and e_list appended (1367-1368). 1017-1032: _family.
stages.inputs: The AP0 slots; Z (n x (r+2)); Zf (n x 2 r_fb); Rr; Ff; W.
stages.outputs:
- z-level legs: A_s = W diag(w1) A_s and P_s likewise. chain-anatomy's identity holds: A_s = P_s C_b.
- The newborn: A = W a_b, P = W.
- Thin stacks: Z_s = P_s Rr_s, Zf_s = P_s Ff_s.
- A_st and P_st as views of all k+1 slots.
stages.approximation: Exact linear transport: exact matmul instead of Strassen leaves the legs error at 0.0396/0.0605. The newborn's first readout uses untruncated legs, so its error at that read is purely birth content (stages 11-12).
stages.observable_in_dumps: A, P, Z, L in LEGS (V30_DUMP_LEGS with V29_DUMP_LAYERS); not in the npz files of oracle_one.py.
stages.exact_counterpart: As in stage 2: mclegs u3_l and P_l are the first-order transport of the true kappa3(z_l).
stages.oracle_hook: None needed, the stage is exact; V26_STRASSEN=0 gives exact arithmetic.

stages.name: 9. Readout of D3 and D21 of z_k (_dslices)
stages.inputs: A_st and P_st (all k+1 slots, formed); Z_st, L_st; the w2b, s, e lists (birth rho, S3c, e_b); the c1, c2 lists plus Z[:, :, r+1] (feed); Zf_st, R1T_st, R2T_st (feedback); Qc, U, the factor slabs, ka, kb.
stages.outputs: D3 (n) and D21 (n x n, zero diagonal; not formed at the last layer).
stages.approximation:
An exact multilinear contraction of the represented tensor sum_s [Sym(X1 x P x Y1) + Sym(M x P x P) + Sym(X3 x P x Y3)], where:
- X1 = 3A + Xt and Y1 = A d(w2) + Yt;
- M = P d(s) + 3A d(e) + Z L^T;
- X3 = A d(c1) + P d(c2) and Y3 = y 1^T.

The two readouts are:
- D3_i = sum_s sum_j [3 w2_j A_ij^2 P_ij + M_ij P_ij^2 + 3 P_ij (A Yt + Xt A w2/3 + Xt Yt/3)_ij] + sum_s R_si y_si.
- D21 = sum_s [LA_s A_s^T + LP_s P_s^T] + (1/3) PP L Z^T + (GY R2^T) F2^T + (GX R1^T) F1^T + (1/3) R^T Y.
- Here LA = 2 AP w2 + PP e (+ feedback) and LP = A A w2 + PP s/3 + (2/3) MP (+ feedback, + (2/3) y o X3).

Confined sources contract exactly through FA_s^T Qc^T. There is no truncation in this stage, only float32/Strassen rounding.
stages.observable_in_dumps: D3_k, D21_k in free dumps; D3own_k, D21own_k in oracle dumps (before replacement); D3, D21 in LEGS.
stages.exact_counterpart: Monte Carlo 'k3' and 'D21' (zero diagonal) in mc4_off*_{full,h0,h1}.npz, split into pair | R3 by T3_pair(k3_y, D21_y) (yclasses, k3chain). The truth's noise floor is about 5% of |t3| at z_1 (k3rem's 0->1 remainder) and falls with depth, so shallow layers need cross-half (h0 x h1) estimates.
stages.oracle_hook:
Existing: V37_ORACLE=D3,D21 (with V37_ORACLE_LAYERS) at 1459-1470.

New per-slot hook for dump runs only, about 2 units per layer. kn = A_st.shape[0] - 1 is the newest slot, which is always dense. Call it before the main call, because it shares bufs:

    d3n, d21n = self._dslices(A_st[kn:], P_st[kn:], Z_st[kn:], L_st[kn:], w2b_list[kn:], s_list[kn:], e_list[kn:], c1_list[kn:], c2_list[kn:], y_list[kn:], n, bufs, r, rfb, Zf_st[kn:], R1T_st[kn:], R2T_st[kn:], need_d21=not trim, ka=0, apb4=legs4['AP0'][2*kn:])
    _own('D3new', li, d3n); _own('D21new', li, d21n)

stages.name: 10. Readout replacement and the M-block subtraction (consistency of the represented y slices)
stages.lines: 1459-1470: V37 records _own, then sets D3 := MC k3 and D21 := MC D21. 1796-1802: D3_w and D21_w are formed from the possibly replaced D3 and D21. 1887-1888: rep21 = D21_w + D21_new. 1959-1962: S3c = K3v - D3_w - D3_new, S21 = K21 - rep21.
stages.inputs: D3, D21 (own or MC), w1, K3v and K21 (the pair program at layer k), D3_new, D21_new.
stages.outputs: S3c and S21: the y-level diagonal and (2,1) slices assigned to the newborn's M-block.
stages.approximation:
Free run: consistent. D3_w and D21_w are exactly the product-gated slices the carried legs hold, so the represented y slices equal K3v and K21 (minus the Rres truncation).

Oracle run: inconsistent. D3_w and D21_w use the MC values while the legs still hold their own slices. The represented y slices therefore become:
- K3v + w1^3 (D3own - D3mc) on the diagonal;
- K21 + w1_i^2 w1_c (D21own - D21mc) - trunc on the (2,1) slice.

The whole previous-layer readout error re-enters through the pair channel, at O(1) for the (2,1) slice and at product-gate weight Phi_i^2 Phi_c (the free run's pair program uses (Phi_i - m_i rho_i) Phi_c). k3chain's 'legs part', own - T3_pair(K3v, K21), therefore contains T3_pair(w1^3 dD3_l, w1^2 w1 dD21_l - trunc_l).
stages.observable_in_dumps: In the all-oracle dump: D3own_l, D21own_l, D3_l/D21_l (equal to MC after replacement), K3v_l, K21_l. KEEP_EXTRA can add D21_w, rep21, S3c, w1.
stages.exact_counterpart: A consistent oracle makes the represented y slices equal to K3v and K21 computed from MC inputs. The artifact term can be computed offline from the existing all-oracle dump plus mc4, with three n x n products per layer.
stages.oracle_hook:
New V41_ORC_CONS=1, three lines: keep D3_leg = D3 and D21_leg = fnp.multiply(D21, 1.0) before the replacement at 1463-1468, and use D3_leg and D21_leg in D3_w and D21_w at 1797-1799.

Offline test with no new run: inc_l = T3_pair(W_(l+1), W o W, Phi_l^3 (D3own_l - k3_l), Phi_l[:,None]^2 (D21own_l - D21_l) Phi_l[None,:]). Subtract it from k3chain's legs_ch and re-report the legs error and its regressions.

stages.name: 11. Birth hub: facet core, D21 feedback (rank R_FB) and K4->K3 feed
stages.lines:
1804-1888:
- a_b = diag(w1) C_off at 1814.
- Feedback at 1815-1848: a rank-2 range finder of D21 with one power iteration (warm sketch from Zf_st[-1] under V29_WARM_FB); F1 = w2 o Qf, R1T = 1.5 FB_SX Bf^T, F2 = w1 o Bf^T, R2T = 0.5 FB_SY Qf o w3 (1828-1831); Xt and Yt at 1832-1833; X1 = 3 a_b + Xt, Y1 = a_b d(w2) + Yt; then D21_new and D3_new.
- Mode-0 branch at 1849-1859: D21_new = a_b^2 w2, no feedback.
- Feed at 1860-1886: dgw = w1^2 dG, y_b = (METRIC_C/4) w2, u_b = y_b dG, c1_b = w1 lam_prev (1869).
stages.inputs: w1, w2, w3 (Phi, phi/s, -alpha phi/s^2); C_off; D21 (own or MC); dG and lam_prev from the kappa4 regen block (1477-1526).
stages.outputs:
- The newborn A leg a_b.
- Thin feedback legs F1, F2, with static R1T, R2T (2014-2020).
- Feed vectors: c1 = w1 lam, c2 = w1^2 dG, y (Z column r+1), u / v = w1^2 (Z and L column r).
- Birth slices D3_new, D21_new.
stages.approximation:
The newborn's all-distinct content at y_k has three parts:
- Facet rho_a Phi_b Phi_c C_ab C_ac + perms: the complete second-order Gaussian term, at coefficient 1.
- Feedback: GC1 (via Yt) and GC2 (via Xt) at half the theorem's weight, plus one of the four Gamma x Gamma cases, with D21 at rank 2.
- Feed: Sym(d(w1) G d(w1) x I x (METRIC_C/4) rho 1^T) with G = diag(dG) + lam C_off. This is the chain's own (2,1,1)-class transfer (V/2) rho_a Phi_b Phi_c, with metric 2I.

Missing at each birth:
- half of GC1 + GC2;
- three Gamma x Gamma cases;
- DS and TRI (negligible);
- the C_bc G_aa / 6 part of (Sigma.G)_aabc. The diagonal block diag(w1^2 dG) of X3 has no all-distinct entries.

Measured:
- |rem| is 8.3-9.6% of |R3| per layer from 1->2 on; GC1 grows from 0.24 to 0.86 of |rem|.
- y2 removes GC1 from the legs error (coefficient 0.66 -> 0.01) but only 8% (D3) and 12% (D21) of the legs-error energy.
- Feedback rank 16 instead of 2 removes 2.5% / 3%.
stages.fitted_elements: lam (LAM table x 0.95, with the adaptive REF_R/BETA rule) enters c1_b and dG. The feedback weights 1.5/0.5 (V18) are half the theorem's. R_FB = 2 is output-tuned. The feedback sketch is warm-started.
stages.observable_in_dumps: DUMPS keys D21_new, rep21, w1, w2, W_all, g4row (via KEEP_EXTRA). D3_new, Xt, Yt, c1/c2/y, dG and lam are not in the npz dumps; V17_DEBUG holds dG and lam.
stages.oracle_hook:
Existing: V18_NO_FB, V18_R_FB, V40_FB_SX/SY, V17_NO_FEED. The per-slot hook of stage 9 gives the newborn's first read.

For note 3j's test (B), the feed's data structure is the kappa3-state injection point. A synthetic slot with A = G, P = I, c1 = 1, c2 = 0, Z[:, r+1] = mu/4 and w2 = s = e = L = Zf = R1T = R2T = 0 reads exactly D3_i = mu_i G_ii / 4, D21_ic = (2 mu_i G_ic + mu_c G_ii) / 12 and all-distinct entries (mu.G/4)_abc. The existing code then gates and transports it; this is cleanest with V21_NO_CONFINE=1.

stages.name: 12. Birth M-block: exact y slices, S_sep, Rres at rank R_RES, Gram weights
stages.lines: 1959-1970: S3c; S21 = K21 - rep21; e_b = W_all[:, i12] - 2 pk1v w1 = 2m - 2 pk1v Phi; S_sep = d(e_b) C_off d(w1); Rres = S21 - S_sep. 1978-1988: rank-4 range finder with sketch w32[:, :4], Q = qr(Rres Om), one power iteration, Bm = Q^T Rres. 1998-2013: Rr = [3 Bm^T | u_b | y_b], L = [Q | w1^2 | 0], so M_b = d(S3c) + 3 a_b d(e) + Rr L^T; the newborn tuple. 2021-2028: the w2b list, dA = 9 + w2^2 + 9 e^2, dP = 1 + S3c^2, the c1, c2, y lists.
stages.inputs: K3v and K21 from the pair program at layer k (memoryless functions of mu, var, C_off, D3, D21 and the lam-based kappa4 slices); D3_w, D21_w, D3_new, D21_new, C_off, w1, pk1v.
stages.outputs: The source's static vectors s = S3c, e = e_b, L; the thin leg Rr (Z = W Rr at the next layer); the Gram weights used by future joins.
stages.approximation:
Diagonal class: exact (S3c).

(2,1) class: S_sep is exact (the leading Wick term c(2,1) C Phi); Rres is kept at rank 4. Rres is:
- the first-order correction from the product gate to the true (2,1) coefficients, (Phi_i - m_i rho_i - Phi_i^2) Phi_c D21_ic + m_i (1 - Phi_i) rho_c D21_ci;
- plus the Mehler-2 C^2 term.

Its structure:
- It is 7-9% of K21.
- Its top direction is the mean (overlap 0.97-0.99); the rest has a spread spectrum. Rank 16 drops 49/37/29% of its norm at layers 5/10/14; rank 4 drops more.
- At layer 0 it is exactly (Phi - Phi^2 - m rho)_i rho_c C_ic^2, which I checked by quadrature to O(C^3). That is a Hadamard square of W0 W0^T: one mean direction plus a bulk that no rank much below n holds.

The rank 4 -> 32 test (0.0396 -> 0.0388) cannot see a spread spectrum. The dropped content enters the legs' (2,1) class and, through W#, the all-distinct memory.
stages.fitted_elements: R_RES = 4, output-tuned (the output is flat from rank 4 to 32).
stages.observable_in_dumps: DUMPS keys K21, K3v, S_sep, Rres, S3c, rep21, D21_w, e_b (via KEEP_EXTRA). The truncation can be reproduced offline from Rres and w32[:, :4].
stages.exact_counterpart: K21 and K3v against Monte Carlo D21_y and k3_y (ysem: K3v within 0.4%, K21 within 2%). The exact M-block is R_RES = n.
stages.oracle_hook: V17_R_RES=1024 gives the exact (2,1) class (about n^3 per source-layer; diagnostic only). Dump trunc = Rres - Q Bm.

key_findings: Exact vs lossy. Between births, the kappa3 machinery is exact algebra: the young/newborn transport family (1311-1331), Z/Zf transport, tier formation (1300-1310), factor rotations and Gram cores (1221-1244, 1260-1288), and the D3/D21 contraction in _dslices (2123-2327). Exact matmul leaves the legs error at 0.0396/0.0605. The only approximations are the product gate (exact first order, no second-order terms for carried content) and the join/nest projections. With AGE_OLD 4 and AGE_OLD2 8 there is a join at EVERY layer 5..14 and a nest move at 9..14, so all confined content is re-projected once per layer; only layer 15 is 'between joins'. Even so, relaxing every truncation at once removes only 12% (D3) and 10% (D21) of the kappa3 readout-error energy (k3_representation_budget). Individually: confinement 6%/4.6%, Rres 4->32 4%/2.3%, feedback 2->16 2.5%/3%. Compression is a minor creator in L2, though its output weight is larger (old-tier rank 288/320/352 gives +7.5/+2.2/+0.1% raw).

The all-oracle 'one-step' kappa3 test is neither one-step nor consistent. V37 (1459-1470) replaces only the readouts; the legs keep the chain's own history. Its per-layer errors therefore match the free run: D3 at layers 2/3/10/14 is 0.0455/0.0375/0.0401/0.0469 against free 0.0451/0.0376/0.0421/0.0509, and D21 at layer 14 is 0.0724 against 0.0742. Moreover, D3_w and D21_w (1796-1799) are built from the replaced values while the carried legs still hold their own slices. So the M-block (S3c, S21 at 1959-1962) writes y slices K3v + w1^3 dD3_l and K21 + w1_i^2 w1_c dD21_l, with d = own - MC. The previous layer's whole readout error re-enters through the pair channel, at O(1) for the (2,1) slice and at product-gate weight, comparable to the free run's pair-program weight (Phi_i - m_i rho_i) Phi_c. k3chain.py's 'legs part' contains T3_pair of this term, and the budget and y2 energy shares are taken relative to it. Its size can be computed now from the existing all-oracle dump (D3own, D21own) and mc4, with three n x n products per layer. The consistent hook (stage 10) is three lines.

In the free run the kappa3 state has multi-layer memory in one class only. The M-block reset (1959-1962) makes the represented y diagonal and (2,1) slices equal to the pair program's K3v and K21 at every layer (minus the rank-4 Rres truncation). All carried memory therefore sits in the all-distinct class held by the legs and moved by the product gate. Creation per layer has exactly three channels: (i) the newborn's all-distinct content against facet + rem: half of GC1/GC2, one of four Gamma x Gamma cases, the lam feed; (ii) the second-order terms the product gate omits on every carried source: gate covariance T_abc rho_a rho_b C_ab, T x Gamma, kappa4 gate terms (1.5-2.4% of the gate per layer, zero mean, compounding); (iii) slice errors written into the M-block: closure within 2%, the pair program's response to inherited input errors, and the Rres truncation, which W# mixes into the all-distinct memory one layer later. y2 fixes GC1 at every birth, hence in all inherited content too, yet removes only 8-12% of the legs-error energy, and compression is about 10%. So channels (ii) and (iii), plus the oracle artifact above, must carry most of the error. For scale: |rem| is 8.3-9.6% of |R3| per layer from 1->2 on, and GC1 grows from 0.24 to 0.86 of |rem| (k3rem).

A creation ledger for the kappa3 state needs no new Monte Carlo. The true newborn's first read at l+1 is N3 = (k3_(l+1) - u3_l, D21_(l+1) - P_l). Here u3 = E[U_i^3] and P = E[U_i^2 U_c], with U = (W_(l+1) o Phi_l)(z_l - mu_l), are already in mc4_off*_legs.npz. They come from the same samples as mc4_full, so the difference works as a control variate and is far less noisy than k3 itself. Its all-distinct part is R3 - leg1 = facet + rem, which k3chain.py already forms. The chain side needs the newest slot's first read, which the stage-9 hook provides at about 2 units per layer. The readout error at l+1 then splits three ways: the pair channel, T3_pair(represented y slices - true y slices at l); the newborn's all-distinct error, New_chain - T3_pair(newborn slices) - (R3 - leg1); and the carried all-distinct error, the remainder (Old_chain - (u3_l, P_l) minus its slice part). Feeding each as a sub-route of fentry's k3 and D21 routes gives an exact layer-by-channel creation map.

lam is the only fitted amplitude that enters the kappa3 state. It enters in two places: through the pair program's kappa4 terms in K3v and K21 (the slices), and through the K4->K3 feed (1860-1886). The feed is the chain's only first-order path from kappa4 into the all-distinct kappa3 memory: by support preservation only (2,1,1) entries feed it, as (V/2) rho_a Phi_b Phi_c. The feed is Sym(d(w1) G d(w1) x I x (METRIC_C/4) rho 1^T) with G = diag(dG) + lam C_off, so it transfers the chain's own trace core with metric 2I (c1_b = w1 lam_prev at 1869; removing the feed costs +4.3% raw). Its diagonal block diag(w1^2 dG) produces no all-distinct entries, so the C_bc G_aa/6 part of (Sigma.G)_aabc never reaches the legs. For the gain mode (G proportional to Sigma) that part equals the kept var_a G_bc/6 part. It is therefore half of the s_a phi_a completion of the y-level gain tangent 2t m_a C^y_bc, unless lam absorbs it. Each birth can thus write a kappa3 gain amplitude that differs from the kappa4 one, which is note 3j's visible error 6 c3 mu var dt3 + 12 c4 var^2 dt4, created per layer. V39_KD changed the kappa4 slices but kept this lam feed and dG, and production's feed also omits K4Q's k4corr. KD's kappa3 births and kappa4 sector are therefore mutually inconsistent, a candidate for the kappa3-kappa4 pair that recurs in the ledger. The same data structure gives test (B) its kappa3-state injection hook (stage 11).

Layer 0->1 is the only place where creation is isolated, but the shallow-layer kappa3 numbers are limited by Monte Carlo noise. z_0 is exactly Gaussian (mu = 0, C_pre = W W^T), and mode 0 has no feedback, no feed and no carried content. The source read at z_1 is therefore facet (complete at second order) + exact K3v + Mehler-2 K21 + exact S_sep + Rres at rank 4. At this layer Rres_0 = (Phi - Phi^2 - m rho)_i rho_c C_ic^2, which is 0.091 rho_c C_ic^2 at alpha = 0 (checked by quadrature): a Hadamard-square bulk that rank 4 drops. The free-running z_1 error is the chain's largest (D3 6.4%, D21 8.3%). But k3rem's 0->1 remainder, which the note assigns to Monte Carlo noise, is already 0.218 |R3| = 5.0% of |t3|. My rough estimate agrees: k3 sampling std sqrt(6/N) sigma^3 is about 1e-3, against an rms kappa3 of about 1e-2 at z_1. The z_1 error, and the shallow layers of every per-layer kappa3 L2 table (k3chain, fb_free), therefore need cross-half (h0 x h1) estimates before they can be read as creation. Note 3e's regression of the legs error on -rem uses the same full-sample R3 estimate on both sides, so its shallow-layer correlation should also be rechecked across halves: it is +0.71 at layer 1->2, where GC1+GC2+DS explain only 8% of rem. Decisive checks: the h0/h1 split at layer 1, and V17_R_RES=1024 (exact M-block) for the z_1 read.
